query:
-- المبيعات الفعلية لشهر يوليو 2026 فقط (بنفس منطق النظام)
SELECT 
  COUNT(*) as count,
  SUM(CAST(COALESCE(netValue, value) AS DECIMAL(14,2))) as actual_sales,
  SUM(CAST(value AS DECIMAL(14,2))) as gross_sales,
  SUM(CAST(COALESCE(discountValue, 0) AS DECIMAL(14,2))) as total_discount
FROM deals 
WHERE stage = 'closed_won' 
  AND isDeleted = 0
  AND (
    -- Priority 1: accountingMonth override
    (accountingMonth = 7 AND accountingYear = 2026)
    OR
    -- Priority 2: closingMonth
    (accountingMonth IS NULL AND closingMonth = 7 AND closingYear = 2026)
    OR
    -- Priority 3: closedAt fallback
    (accountingMonth IS NULL AND closingMonth IS NULL AND closedAt BETWEEN '2026-07-01' AND '2026-07-31 23:59:59')
  );
